role: Independent read-only P2-5 static review; no production or formal tests authored
decision: Suitable for adoption with requested stage gates; no new static blocker found
reasoning: Cache object is local to each matches call; three fields own independent optional strings, no shared cross-document state.
Recursive evaluation borrows one stable object; a populated cache is not reassigned, so returned string_view stays live during recursion.
Host/type early rejection, AND/OR short circuit, NOT, any excluding URL, ASCII-only folding and leaf boundary behavior remain unchanged.
Proposed8 documents evaluated forwards/backwards16 times cover field isolation, prior-document leakage, C++20 and node.jsx literal boundaries and non-ASCII case behavior with correct expectations.
limits: Only repeated lowercase conversion within a matches call is removed. score_match/highlight still have separate processing.
Store mutex scope is unchanged, and the patch does not claim all scanning contention is removed.
No fresh performance ratio, compilation or complete gate pass claimed by this static review.
